protocol.selection: The initial reference is included as the common baseline for the three methods. At each later time, the curve retains the lowest ADD among that baseline and completed eligible agent trials. No later trial is backdated to zero.
protocol.clock: Recorded elapsed active refinement minutes; trial completion is the availability time. Independent final verification replays excluded.
protocol.eligibility: Completed physics and executor; finite nonnegative ADD; known initial-object violations excluded. Initial-object flags are unavailable in the archived independent-swarm CSV.
protocol.missingness: All curves begin with the measured initial-reference execution at minute zero. The same full task cohort is averaged at every time. No backfilling of agent trials or zero-error imputation.
protocol.independent_swarm: Ten HUMOTO histories comprise four 15-minute workers followed by a 15-minute continuation without experience. Continuation timestamps include the first 15 minutes.
protocol.interpretation: Best recorded ADD among the initial reference and completed agent trials, which can differ from the final submitted execution scored in the tables.

initial_reference.meaning: Initial, unmodified kinematic reference executed with frozen SONIC and the supplied finger targets, before agent refinement. This is a physical rollout, not a kinematic replay.
initial_reference.evaluation: Re-evaluated on 2026-11-02 from the original task input bundles using object_path_v1. Assigned to refinement minute zero because this reference is provided before the agent starts. Evaluation time is not included in the original agent budget.
initial_reference.selection: The initial reference is included as the common baseline for the three methods. At each later time, the curve retains the lowest ADD among that baseline and completed eligible agent trials. No later trial is backdated to zero.
initial_reference.weighting: Equal weight for every task, fixed dataset cohorts from minute zero onward.
